aiResearchSummary.text: Actipulse Neuroscience (YC W22) is researching non-invasive brain stimulation methods, such as repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation, for the treatment and prevention of brain tumors, mild cognitive impairment, dementia, Alzheimer's disease, and substance use disorder. Their developments include devices and protocols for applying low intensity pulsed magnetic fields to stimulate neurons, supporting neuromodulation therapeutics for various neurological and psychiatric conditions.
